evidence_cards.document_title: Scaling R-GCN Training with Graph Summarization
evidence_cards.main_contribution: This quote demonstrates that graph summarization techniques can effectively reduce computational resources while maintaining or improving model performance.

sources.quote: After training the R-GCN on the graph summary, we transfer the weights back to the original graph and attempt to perform inference on it. We obtain reasonable results on the AIFB, MUTAG and AM datasets. Our experiments show that training on the graph summary can yield a comparable or higher accuracy to training on the original graphs.
sources.title: Scaling R-GCN Training with Graph Summarization

evidence_cards.document_title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Summarization with Graph Neural Networks
evidence_cards.main_contribution: This quote highlights the shift towards using deep learning techniques, particularly GNNs, for graph summarization, which aligns with the novelty point of utilizing advanced techniques to accelerate model training and reduce computational resource usage.

sources.quote: In the past, most graph summarization techniques sought to capture the most important part of a graph statistically. However, today, the high dimensionality and complexity of modern graph data are making deep learning techniques more popular. Hence, this paper presents a comprehensive survey of progress in deep learning summarization techniques that rely on graph neural networks (GNNs).
sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Summarization with Graph Neural Networks
